sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Choose the correct accusative form for each sentence

items.hint: Врач (doctor) is alive. How do animate masculine nouns behave in accusative?
items.explanation: Врач is animate masculine. Accusative follows genitive: врача.

items.hint: Газета is feminine. Feminine -а changes to what in accusative?
items.explanation: Газета (feminine -а) changes to газету in accusative: -а → -у.

items.hint: Is a park alive or not?
items.explanation: Парк is inanimate masculine. Inanimate masculine nouns don't change in accusative.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I see the cat. (кот = animate masculine)
minimalPairs.explanation: Кот (cat) is animate masculine. Accusative = genitive: кота.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I see the chair. (стул = inanimate masculine)
minimalPairs.explanation: Стул (chair) is inanimate masculine. No change in accusative: стул.

minimalPairs.context: Он слушает _____. (He listens to a song.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He listens to a song. (песня = feminine -я)

minimalPairs.explanation: Море (neuter) stays the same in accusative. Neuter nouns never change.

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Accusative forms for animate/inanimate masculine and neuter
explanations: Отец is animate masculine. Accusative = genitive: отца.
Журнал is inanimate masculine. No change in accusative: журнал.
Яблоко is neuter. Neuter nouns don't change in accusative: яблоко.

sets.title: Sort and Correct
sets.description: Sort nouns by their accusative behavior and fix case errors
sets.descriptionRussian: Рассортируйте существительные и исправьте падежные ошибки

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: does this noun change form in accusative?

errorCorrection.explanation: Друг is animate masculine. Accusative = genitive: друга.

errorCorrection.hint: Газета is the direct object. What case does it need?
errorCorrection.explanation: Газета is feminine -а. In accusative: -а → -у, so газету.
Учитель is animate masculine (soft-stem). Accusative = genitive: учителя.

errorCorrection.hint: Машина is the direct object being bought.
errorCorrection.explanation: Машина is feminine -а. In accusative: -а → -у, so машину.

translation.hint: I = я, see = вижу, boy (accusative) = мальчика
She = она, bought = купила, book (accusative) = книгу
We = мы, see = видим, school (accusative) = школу

sets.title: Spot the Pattern
sets.description: Recognize how animacy and gender determine the accusative form
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите, как одушевлённость и род определяют винительный падеж

patternRecognition.question: What do all these accusative forms have in common?
options: They are all animate masculine nouns
patternRecognition.answer: They are all animate masculine nouns
patternRecognition.explanation: All of these are animate masculine nouns. They take genitive-like endings in accusative (-а).

patternRecognition.question: Why do these nouns NOT change in accusative?
patternRecognition.explanation: These are all inanimate masculine nouns. Inanimate masculine accusative = nominative (no change).

patternRecognition.question: What ending pattern do these accusative forms share?
patternRecognition.explanation: All are feminine nouns ending in -а, which changes to -у in accusative.

blanks: Она ждёт _____. (She is waiting for a friend. - male friend)
Мы слушаем _____. (We listen to the teacher.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Mixed accusative forms across genders and animacy
hints: Дверь is feminine soft-sign. Soft-sign feminines don't change in accusative.
explanations: Друг is animate masculine. Accusative = genitive: друга.
Дверь (feminine -ь) stays the same in accusative: дверь.
Учитель is animate masculine (soft-stem). Accusative = genitive: учителя.
Здание is neuter. Neuter nouns don't change in accusative: здание.

minimalPairs.context: Я знаю _____. (I know the cook. - повар is a person)
minimalPairs.explanation: Повар (cook) is animate masculine. Accusative = genitive: повара.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I see the umbrella. (зонт = inanimate masculine)
minimalPairs.explanation: Зонт (umbrella) is inanimate masculine. No change in accusative.

minimalPairs.context: Она купила _____. (She bought a week's vacation.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She bought a week of vacation. (неделя = feminine -я)
minimalPairs.explanation: Неделя (week) is feminine -я. In accusative: -я → -ю, so неделю.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A final round mixing all accusative skills together
sets.descriptionRussian: Финальный раунд: все виды заданий на винительный падеж

items.prompt: Мальчик любит _____. (The boy loves his grandfather.)
items.hint: Дедушка ends in -а like a feminine noun, but refers to a man.
items.explanation: Дедушка declines like a feminine -а noun despite being masculine: дедушка → дедушку in accusative.

items.hint: Ключи (keys) are inanimate. What happens to inanimate plurals?
items.explanation: Ключи is inanimate plural. Inanimate plural accusative = nominative plural: ключи.

items.hint: Студенты are people. What happens to animate plurals?
items.explanation: Студенты is animate plural. Animate plural accusative = genitive plural: студентов.
Кресло (armchair) is neuter. Neuter nouns don't change in accusative: кресло.

items.prompt: Я жду _____. (I'm waiting for my sister.)
items.hint: Ждать takes accusative. Сестра is feminine -а.
items.explanation: Ждать (to wait for) requires accusative. Сестра → сестру (-а → -у).

items.prompt: Мы знаем этого _____. (We know this artist.)
items.explanation: Артист is animate masculine. Accusative = genitive: артиста.

items.prompt: Дети нашли _____. (The children found a ball.)
items.explanation: Мяч (ball) is inanimate masculine. No change in accusative: мяч.

errorCorrection.explanation: Подруга is feminine -а. In accusative: -а → -у, so подругу. Don't confuse with masculine -а → -а genitive pattern.
Дедушка declines like feminine -а: accusative is дедушку, not дедушке (which is dative/prepositional).
Компьютер is inanimate masculine. No change in accusative: компьютер, not компьютера.
